promptSet.description:
Ghatak Chrome Productivity Suite – Ghatak Chrome Extension: Speed Up Your Daily AI Workflows

A powerful, lightweight browser extension designed for developers, students, and digital creators. Instant keyboard shortcuts to summon AI prompts, summarize lengthy web articles, and extract code blocks.

Built for knowledge workers, tech operators, and fast-paced teams, Ghatak Chrome Productivity Suite removes administrative bottlenecks, automates high-frequency routines, and maximizes daily output.

Key Features:
• Add Ghatak to your Chrome browser.
• Press the shortcut key on any long article or documentation page.
• Read the instant executive briefing without leaving the tab.
• Bulleted executive brief highlighting the 3 primary points of a 5,000-word essay.

Instagram Breakdown & Resource Guide: https://www.instagram.com/p/DYUsCZdy6YA/
